info.description:
Complete collection generated from the SugarBliss Express server routes.
Set authToken for customer APIs and adminToken for admin-only APIs.
Run Health and Authentication first; requests save IDs for later folders.
Gemini, Lalamove and ZaloPay credentials stay in server/.env and are never stored here.
ZaloPay wallet and Visa checkout are sandbox-only; see server/docs/PAYMENTS_SANDBOX.md.

request.description: New accounts automatically receive currently active, dated autoAssignOnRegister vouchers. Returns vouchers and voucherCount. Ownership is assigned by the server, not registration input. Existing accounts are not retroactively granted a welcome voucher.
Set adminEmail and adminPassword before sending. Saves the admin JWT separately.

item.name: Admin Dashboard
item.description: Admin-only aggregate data for dashboard KPIs, sales chart, best sellers, and recent orders.

item.name: Admin Orders
item.description: Requires adminToken. Lalamove fulfillment is provider-managed; only Store Pickup has manual forward transitions. Do not mutate real customer orders during tests.

exec: pm.test('Admin list returned', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(200); const data = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(data.orders).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(data.total).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(data.pages).to.be.at.least(1); });

request.description: Real paginated orders with customer and item snapshots, delivery method, display status and permitted pickupActions. Optional literal search (order number/product, max 100 chars), status (In Progress, Delivered, Cancelled, Failed, Ready for Pickup), month YYYY-MM and timezoneOffset minutes east of UTC. limit 1-100. Default month is all dates.

Any customer's order detail for admin, with saved item prices, totals, contact, payment status and safe Lalamove tracking link. No gateway URL, checkout key, coordinates or credentials. providerManaged orders always have empty pickupActions.

Explicitly choose a test pickup ID. Forward-only PREPARING -> READY_FOR_PICKUP -> COLLECTED. For the second step, set pickupStatus COLLECTED; pending COD also requires cashReceived:true, marking payment Paid. Online/Bank Transfer must already be Paid. Collected sets purchase status Delivered, displayed Collected. No stock or voucher release. Lalamove/Express, terminal orders, backwards transitions, forged fields or payment races are rejected.

Select an existing Lalamove booking. Calls the existing provider status-read service, not a new delivery booking. Uses current webhook ordering/terminal safeguards. No manual status body is accepted or needed. Store Pickup cannot use this endpoint.

item.name: Payments (ZaloPay + Visa Sandbox)
item.description: See server/docs/PAYMENTS_SANDBOX.md. Wallet and Visa use one ZaloPay sandbox app; keys stay in server/.env. Run these requests in order after login and selecting a real product.

request.description: Lists availability. Configure keys on server only.
Use ZaloPay or Visa. Online payment requires a new prepaid quote, not a COD quote.
Reset checkoutKey to empty ONLY for a new order, not after a timeout. Stock is reserved, delivery waits for Paid. Pickup: omit quote, use deliveryMethod=pickup and shippingAddress.
Open the returned paymentUrl in your browser. Use a sandbox wallet/test card, never a real card. Amount comes from MongoDB, no card details go to SugarBliss.

exec: const data = pm.response.json(); if (data.url) pm.collectionVariables.set('paymentUrl', data.url);

request.description: Server queries sandbox payment truth. Paid dispatches Lalamove once. Confirmed unpaid expiry becomes Failed and restores stock once. Closing a browser or network errors do not force failure.
Returns payment and shipping status.
Only original gateway data signed with KEY2 is accepted. Empty placeholders deliberately fail verification. Prefer real provider callbacks. HTTP 200; return_code 1=success, 2=invalid, 0=retryable.

item.name: Visa Card Checkout (Sandbox)
item.description: Standalone Visa/international-card test through the ZaloPay hosted sandbox. Store pickup avoids Lalamove/geocoding configuration; use the general Payments folder for delivery. Login and set productId first. Run manually in order: this creates a real unpaid SugarBliss order and reserves stock. Do not enter real card details or put API keys in Postman. The sandbox app must support international_card. See server/docs/PAYMENTS_SANDBOX.md.

request.description: Configuration check, not a live card-processing test. The merchant app also needs international-card payment enabled.

Reset visaCheckoutKey only for a genuinely new order, never after a timeout. Repeating this request returns the same owned order. For standard delivery obtain a prepaid Visa quote using the general Payments folder.

exec: const data = pm.response.json(); if (data.id && data.paymentMethod === 'Visa') pm.collectionVariables.set('visaOrderId', data.id);

request.description: Open visaPaymentUrl in your browser and enter only official sandbox card details on the ZaloPay site. No PAN, CVV or expiry is sent to SugarBliss. Ready sessions are reused. If the gateway shows maintenance, wait and retry the same link while unexpired; do not create another order.

Queries ZaloPay on the server. Closing the card form or returning with status=1 does not mark an order Paid. The verified amount must equal the saved order total. An abandoned unpaid order becomes Failed after its payment window expires and the server verifies it. Failed orders cannot restart payment; use a new order/key.

exec: const data = pm.response.json(); pm.test('Visa payment queried', () => pm.expect(data.method).to.eql('Visa'));

request.description: Read the saved payment status. Pickup has no Lalamove dispatch; standard online orders dispatch once after verified payment.

Search active recipients by name/email. Returns IDs, names, emails and each user's voucherCount; no passwords or tokens. Set voucherRecipientId to a selected user ID.

request.description: Admin creates a percent or fixed VND voucher and assigns it only to selected active userIds by default. Optional autoAssignOnRegister:true also grants eligible future registrations and permits empty/omitted userIds. Never implicitly assigns all existing accounts. Code must be unique, including deleted codes. Discount never applies to delivery. usedCount and usageOrders cannot be set by the caller.

request.description: Creates an additional test campaign, not the seeded WELCOME50K code. Register a new email afterward and check GET /api/vouchers/mine. No current account is assigned this offer. Delete voucherId afterward to stop future grants and remove this test campaign's ownership. Campaign expiry is shared across recipients, not 30 days per signup.
Admin-only delete. Deactivates and archives the voucher, removes it from every user's ownership and voucherCount. Retains past order discount snapshots; retries are safe.

Preview a voucher assigned to the authenticated account. subtotal must be a positive integer VND product subtotal, excluding shipping. Returns discountScope=products and finalSubtotal. Does not reserve usage; POST /api/orders recalculates prices, atomically reserves a use and checks ownership. Validation errors have VOUCHER_* codes.

item.name: AI Chatbox (Gemini)
item.description: Authenticated Sugar Bliss assistant grounded in the active product catalog.

request.description: Requires GEMINI_API_KEY in server/.env. Returns { reply, model, products }. Each products item contains id, name, price, image (first catalog image), category, inStock, and detailPath for a clickable chat card. Only active catalog products linked in the reply are included, with duplicates removed. The Gemini key is never sent from Postman or the browser.
